paragraphs.text: The Shadow Gate was an artifact from Kamigawa that allowed a person to travel from one shadow to another in the world.

It was given to Uramon by the Myojin of Night's Reach and later stolen by Toshi Umezawa . Among other rewards, Night bound the Gate to Toshi's body by turning it into a kanji on his chest. Apart from convenient traveling, the Shadow Gate made it possible for Toshi to steal That Which Was Taken from Konda .
Toshi's descendant Tetsuko Umezawa practices a similar magic.
